artworks.title: The Old Cock
artworks.medium: conté crayon with brush and brown-black wash on wove paper

artworks.title: The Haunted House
artworks.description: This print depicts an ornate building resembling a mansion or estate. The building is centrally positioned and dominates the scene with its roofline, turrets, and chimneys. Detailed vegetation surrounds the building, the dark leaves blending into the architecture. At the bottom of the print, animals including cows, goats, and chickens graze in front of a gated fence. A woman and child stand among the animals, the woman wearing a dress and a large hat and holding a parasol. Faint, wispy clouds fill the sky above, with countless dark birds flying above the house and resting on the roof. Upon closer inspection, more people become visible, looking out of windows and balconies at the top of the house. Some of these people appear translucent, with parts of the architecture visible through them.

artworks.title: The Haunted House
artworks.description: The image shows a stately building with arched windows and decorative elements carved into the stone facade. The sky above contains clouds and a flock of birds. The fine and detailed brushstrokes capture textures of brickwork, foliage, light, and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of sepia or brown. The ground features farm animals, a figure, and children, suggesting a pastoral setting. Behind the building, trees and ornate structures add depth to the scene.

artworks.title: Branches
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed view of a tree with numerous branches and vines weaving throughout the composition. The central tree trunk is showcased, displaying its textured bark and network of limbs extending outward. The horizon is not clearly defined, and the scene is filled with branches reaching in different directions. The technique displays intricate line work with fine, precise strokes creating a web-like pattern. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of black, grey, and white, emphasizing the lines and creating depth. In the distance, branches continue, filling the space with a network of lines against a lighter background.

artworks.title: Hans Brosamer
artworks.description: This print shows a portrait of a man in an oval frame looking off to the left. The man has light skin, wavy, light-colored hair, a long mustache, and strong cheekbones. He is wearing a robe or tunic with a white collar and buttons down the front. Behind him, the background is plain, off-white paper. Outside of the oval, the background is decorated with thin black lines. At the bottom, there is an inscription with the name "Hanns Brosamer," and the number "1541."

artworks.title: Solomon Worshipping Idols
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 7.8 x 9.7 cm (3 1/16 x 3 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor scene with multiple figures and a statue. The gathering includes people in classical attire, with a central bearded figure kneeling before a statue on a pedestal. The statue appears to be of a horned figure, possibly representing a deity. Swirling forms surround the statue, suggesting movement. Other individuals are engaging with each other, dressed in elaborate garments, some wearing crowns or headdresses. The space has architectural features like columns in the background, creating a rich setting. The drawing depicts a complex composition with historical or mythological significance.

artworks.title: Samson and Delilah
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 8.1 x 9.8 cm (3 3/16 x 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene depicting armored figures engaged in various activities. One figure is seated with a bowl being held to their head by another, while a third stands beside them holding chains. The setting is an intricately detailed room with arched windows, heavy drapery, and ornate furnishings, including a table set with vessels. A window in the background lets in light, illuminating the medieval ambiance, highlighted by the soldiers’ elaborate costumes and weaponry. The drawing has strong line work and shading, giving depth and texture to the scene.

artworks.title: Exempel und Lehr Jetziger Welt Lauf
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene intertwined with calligraphic text. The image displays two skeletons, each cloaked and posed behind two different figures on either side of the text block. On the left, a skeleton embraces a nude man holding a spear. On the right, a skeleton stands behind a woman in elegant attire holding what appears to be a fan or a feather. Above, an arch of twisted, leafless tree branches frames the top of the scene. The central text is in gothic script with elaborate flourishes, surrounded by the scenes.

artworks.title: Prudence
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.9 x 29.3 cm (8 5/8 x 11 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a detailed scene depicting various activities around a medieval village. The image is in the style of Pieter Bruegel the Elder. The image is rich in detail and is divided into several vignettes, each capturing different aspects of village life. In the foreground, there are figures engaged in activities such as barrel-making, pouring liquid, and organizing goods. Also featured is an elegantly dressed figure. In the center and to the right of the image, people are involved in agriculture and near a building. The background shows a river scene with a small boat, trees, and houses. The image depicts various textures and activities, giving it a dynamic quality.

artworks.title: Temperance
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene featuring various activities and figures under a night sky with a large moon and stars. In the foreground, figures are engaged in scholarly and creative tasks, including reading, writing, and playing instruments. In the center, a character in robes and a crown-like hat gestures towards the viewer. Architectural and theatrical elements suggest a mix of a stage and a workshop or academy. Various symbolic objects like scrolls and globes fill the space. The scene depicts human endeavors with detailed costumes and expressions. The drawing is monochromatic with fine line work and shading.

artworks.title: Faith
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This image depicts a religious gathering in a grand architectural setting. The scene is filled with figures engaging in various religious activities within a large, arched interior. A central platform holds an elevated figure, surrounded by people in religious attire. The architecture includes tall pillars and intricate arches. Onlookers fill the space, creating a lively atmosphere. There are liturgical elements present, such as a cross. Detailed figures suggest a complex narrative, with some gesturing or reading. The depiction includes symbols of faith and an inscription at the bottom.

artworks.title: Fortitude
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is an image of a fantastical battle scene. It includes a chaotic and surreal battlefield with unusual and mythological animals, soldiers using various weapons, and architectural structures. The drawing features detailed figures engaged in combat, riding horses, or lying defeated. The landscape includes a body of water with ships sailing in the background. A central figure stands near a column with wings and a robe. The intricate lines and composition suggest rich narrative and complex symbolism.

artworks.title: Justice
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a large gathering around executions and court proceedings. The scene is divided into sections depicting a courtroom setting, individuals being tortured and executed, and gallows and a burning stake for public executions. The drawing illustrates a grim view of justice and punishment through detailed etching.

artworks.title: Hope
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene on a turbulent sea with various allegorical elements. The image shows a fortified structure where people and animals are observing or participating in the chaos around them. The water is filled with exaggerated waves, overturning boats, and numerous struggling figures. A prominent figure at the center appears calm amidst the storm with a shovel in hand. A large fish with a surprising expression emerges from the waves. In the background, there are structures and tree silhouettes against the skyline. The image is detailed with intricate lines, creating texture and depth, typical of Northern European engravings from the late Renaissance period.

artworks.title: Charity
artworks.artist: Philip Galle after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a busy village scene with various activities depicted. The image shows multiple figures engaged in different tasks in a village or town setting. In the upper left section, a man stands by a large cask. The central area is bustling with figures interacting with each other. There are several buildings, including one that resembles a tavern or workshop. In front of the building, other activities are taking place, including what appears to be a medical or caregiving scene. The lower left corner features a pile of large baskets. The composition is detailed and intricate, showcasing daily life and commerce of the depicted era.

artworks.title: Magdalena Poenitens (The Penitent Magdalene)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of a mountainous landscape. Intricate line work depicts various elements such as mountain ridges, trees, buildings, a figure near a wooden shelter and a skull, rocks, a river, a path through a forest, a village nestled in cliffs, and castles and settlements on towering mountains. The color palette is monochromatic, in shades of sepia, giving the image an antique appearance with depth and detailed craftsmanship.

artworks.title: Milites Requiescentes (Soldiers at Rest)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from an elevated vantage point. In the center, there are rugged mountains with a castle. Closer to the viewer, there is a large tree over a path where armored soldiers rest. To the left, a small village with clustered buildings can be seen, including a church with a spire. Beyond the village, there are plains, rivers, and clusters of trees extending into the distance. The image is monochromatic with detailed line work suggesting texture and depth. The tree, leaves, and terrain are intricately etched, creating a visually engaging scene. The overall tone is sepia, giving the image an antique aesthetic.

artworks.title: Euntes in Emaus (The Pilgrims to Emmaus)
artworks.artist: Johannes and Lucas van Doetechum after Pieter Bruegel the Elder
artworks.description: This image depicts a landscape with figures walking on a path surrounded by trees and foliage. A thatched-roof structure is visible nearby. In the distance, there are rolling hills, a fortified town, and a winding river with boats. The sun is shown either setting or rising over the scene. The artwork uses intricate lines and hatching to create texture and depth. The color scheme is monochromatic, with varying shades of black and white emphasizing contrast and detail.

artworks.title: Woman and Death
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing facing slightly to the right. She is wearing an elaborate dress with puffy shoulders, a textured bodice, and a long skirt. Her head is adorned with a patterned headscarf or hat, and she holds flowers in her left hand and an hourglass in her right hand. A skeleton stands behind her with an arm draped across her back. The background shows grassy terrain with the skeleton's foot stepping over a bone. A column of text, reading 'ONMEM IN HOMINE VENYNAM ADOLET MORSMIS,' is on the right side of the image. The letters 'FB' are in the upper left corner.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 4.1 × 3.2 cm (1 5/8 × 1 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman holding a flaming heart, standing in profile with a cherub beside her. A cow is reclining in the background. It features inscriptions at the top with the word "VENVS" and the date "1569" with initials.

artworks.title: Samson and Delilah
artworks.description: The image shows two figures in an outdoor setting. A woman leans over a reclining man, with her hands near his head. The woman has a detailed face, focused expressions, wavy hair with a decorative element. The man has a bushy beard and hair, potentially with closed eyes. He wears flowing garments and distinct footwear. The setting includes trees, foliage, grass, a small path, a round tray with a pitcher and goblet, and a brick wall or structure at the edge of the scene.

artworks.title: Saint Luke Painting the Portrait of the Virgin
artworks.description: The image shows several figures, with a woman and child in the center. The woman is seated in a regal pose, holding the child on her lap. She has a solemn expression and wears a headscarf. The angels have curly hair and one figure is painting at an easel. The background includes architectural details and a landscape with clouds and foliage.

artworks.title: The Old White King Sending His Messengers to Portugal
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a woodcut illustration. A person wearing a crown and ornate robes is in the center, extending a hand towards another person. This individual is dressed in richly decorated attire with a high collar and puffed sleeves, and has a sword or dagger at the side. To the left, another person in a long robe stands beside a table holding a covered goblet and a pitcher. Onlookers, possibly courtiers, are on both sides. The background includes pillars supporting a structure, a tapestry or curtain behind the figures, an open window showing a mountainous landscape with a village or citadel on a hill.

artworks.title: Three Men and a Boy in the Court of a Castle, to the Right Three Men on a Staircase
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a medieval scene at the entrance of a building. The drawing depicts a gathering at the base of a set of steps leading to an arched wooden door, set within a stone wall. The architecture includes peaked and rounded arches, brickwork patterns, and decorative carvings. There are several figures present, dressed in flowing robes and garments typical of a historical period. The setting suggests a formal occasion or meeting, potentially at a church or a royal residence. The composition is marked by a high level of detail in the etching style, emphasizing clothing and expressions.
